description: Manage DNS records for the Ericsson IPWorks DNS server. The module uses the ipwcli to deploy the DNS records.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: The IP address for the A or AAAA record. Required for type=A or type=AAAA.

parameters.name: container
parameters.description: Sets the container zone for the record.

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: Sets one of the possible flags of NAPTR record. Required for type=NAPTR. Choices: "S" "A" "U" "P"

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Sets the order of the NAPTR record. Required for type=NAPTR.

parameters.name: port
parameters.description: Sets the port of the SRV record. Required for type=SRV.

parameters.name: preference
parameters.description: Sets the preference of the NAPTR record. Required for type=NAPTR.

parameters.name: priority
parameters.description: Sets the priority of the SRV record. Default: 10

parameters.name: replacement
parameters.description: Sets the replacement of the NAPTR record. Required for type=NAPTR.

parameters.name: service
parameters.description: Sets the service of the NAPTR record. Required for type=NAPTR.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Whether the record should exist or not. Choices: "absent" "present" ← (default)

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Sets the target of the SRV record. Required for type=SRV.

parameters.name: ttl
parameters.description: Sets the TTL of the record. Default: 3600

parameters.name: weight
parameters.description: Sets the weight of the SRV record. Default: 10

examples:
- name: Create A record
  community.general.ipwcli_dns:
    dnsname: example.com
    type: A
    container: ZoneOne
    address: 127.0.0.1

- name: Remove SRV record if exists
  community.general.ipwcli_dns:
    dnsname: _sip._tcp.test.example.com
    type: SRV
    container: ZoneOne
    ttl: 100
    state: absent
    target: example.com
    port: 5060

- name: Create NAPTR record
  community.general.ipwcli_dns:
    dnsname: test.example.com
    type: NAPTR
    preference: 10
    container: ZoneOne
    ttl: 100
    order: 10
    service: 'SIP+D2T'
    replacement: '_sip._tcp.test.example.com.'
    flags: S

return_values.name: record
return_values.description: The created record from the input params. Returned: always
